description:
Versant’s Software Engineering team provides core services to our business, underpinning our strategy and execution of linear & digital distribution of content, platforms, and data. As a Developer for Workplace Integrations, you will build and implement feature rich tools and services that empower our employees in their day-to-day experiences at Versant. Utilizing automations and AI-driven engagement experiences throughout our employee experiences, this role will focus on connecting collaboration, communications, security and workplace technologies through cohesive frameworks and data services.
 You will coordinate closely with our leadership team to understand real employee workflows and friction points in order to design & deliver simple, working integrations that improve employee experience. Examples include wiring notifications into collaboration tools, automating workflows across workplace systems, or bridging physical systems with digital platforms.
 This role is hands-on and execution focus, developing backend services and client integrations to supplement our workplace applications and provide an enriched experience for our teams at Versant. Working through iterative development practices, from prototyping to production deployments, you will have opportunity to ship workplace solutions quickly and reliably.
 Key Responsibilities
 Develop API-first workflow integrations for workplace applications & AI tooling, providing search capabilities, production workflows, and automations.
 Provide client interfaces and frameworks to create dashboards, visualizations, and supplemental tools to reduce process complexity.
 Implement service integrations for CI/CD & automation, providing status and messaging across internal platforms for visibility and metrics gathering.
 Collaborate closely with Product Management and Engineering leadership to define actionable development tasks from user requirements.
 
 Demonstrated experience building and delivering software solutions, ideally in environments focused on user workflows or internal tools.
 Experience working in Agile development practices, and a strong understanding of SDLC & development best practices.
 Strong full-stack development skills: Backend & integration development in Node with TypeScript and JavaScript
 Client frameworks such as Vue.js, React, and Angular
 Productivity & communication tools like Slack
 
 Experience designing and implementing API-first integrations, webhooks, and event-driven workflows.
 Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools & automations, such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
 Background in cloud based environments like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
 Understanding of application architecture fundamentals, especially serverless & event-driven systems.
 Strong understanding of security practices, and familiarity with authorization flows & user governance.
 
 As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.
 If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to candidateaccessibility@versantmedia.com .
 VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.
 VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.
